data.long_meaning: Maarisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess of death, Yamuna. In Hindu mythology, Yamuna is the goddess of death who is believed to escort the souls of the deceased to the afterlife. The name Maarisha is a beautiful and evocative reminder of the cycle of life and death. The name Maarisha carries the meaning “Goddess of Death” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Maarisha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of death and live with faith, good character and purpose.
